description: This file defines an NVIDIA provider plugin entry for the openclaw system. It imports functions to define a provider plugin and to build the provider, then exports a plugin entry with specified metadata and provider configuration.

methods.name: defineSingleProviderPluginEntry
methods.description: Creates a provider plugin entry with specified configuration.

methods.name: buildNvidiaProvider
methods.description: Builds and returns the NVIDIA provider object for the plugin.
